rationale: SNY has gapped up ~3.9% on no news catalyst, with volume running at 6.89x the normal pace — suggesting a news-driven move that has already largely played out. Price is sitting near the session high with a very tight ATR ($0.08 on 5m bars), offering poor reward-to-risk for either direction: chasing the gap long risks a mean-reversion fade, while shorting into strong momentum with no clear catalyst exhaustion signal is equally dangerous. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.18%, VIXY +6.3%), which adds uncertainty to holding a gap-up long, and with no news to anchor a thesis, the edge is insufficient to justify a new position.
